name: Father Forgive Me: The Sins We Share
source:
Yuel is the rightful king of Verren, but he has no chance to claim the throne. His father's once-loyal advisor, Salim, has been plotting against Yuel in the shadows for years, and once Yuel's father dies, Salim swoops in to claim the throne for himself.

Left with no choice but to flee for his life, Yuel escapes into the countryside with his father's former right-hand man, Armand. Armand has a plan to ensure Yuel's safety even as civil war rages in the capital, but it's a risky one.

While the king's men try to reclaim the throne from Salim's grasp, Yuel will live in the small village of Aylesbury, hundreds of miles away from the fighting. Once in Aylesbury, Yuel must live in its abbey, dress as a nun, and... pretend to be a woman?

Armand's plan is a convoluted one, and things are made more complex still when Yuel runs into the local priest, Father Malek. Why does he look so familiar, and why is he so interested in Yuel? Can this father really be trusted, and what, exactly, is he plotting?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5305380/Father_Forgive_Me_The_Sins_We_Share/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
尤埃尔本是维伦王国名正言顺的合法君王，却根本无缘登上王位。父亲昔日忠心耿耿的顾问萨利姆已在暗中谋划多年，算计着除掉尤埃尔；待老国王一驾崩，萨利姆便趁机夺权篡位。

走投无路的尤埃尔只得在父亲昔日左膀右臂阿尔芒的护送下逃往乡间保命。尽管王都内战正酣，阿尔芒却拟定了一条确保尤埃尔平安无虞的妙计——只不过这计策着实凶险万分。

当忠于先王的旧部奋力从萨利姆手中夺回王位之际，尤埃尔将隐居在远离战火数百英里之外的小村庄艾尔斯伯里。抵达艾尔斯伯里后，尤埃尔必须住进当地修道院，换上修女服，并且……假扮成女人？

阿尔芒的计划本就曲折繁复，而当尤埃尔偶遇当地神父马利克后，局势更是变得扑朔迷离。为什么这位神父看起来如此眼熟，又为何对尤埃尔抱有如此浓厚的兴趣？这位神父当真值得信任吗？他暗地里究竟又在谋划着什么？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5305380/Father_Forgive_Me_The_Sins_We_Share/]Steam[/url]]
